newsitem.title: USA: U.S. to sell $8 bln of inflation-indexed notes.
newsitem.headline: U.S. to sell $8 bln of inflation-indexed notes.

text.p: The Treasury Department said on Wednesday that it will auction $8 billion of 9-3/4-year inflation-indexed notes on April 8 to raise cash.

The notes will be issued on April 15 and mature on Jan 15, 2007. This is just the second auction by Treasury of inflation-indexed securities. The notes to be sold on April 8 are a reopening of the first issue of 10-year indexed notes dated Jan 15.
The CUSIP number for the notes will be 9128272M3.
Treasury said amounts bid for by Federal Reserve banks for their own accounts or for foreign and international monetary authorities will be added to the offering.

Minimum bid amounts are $1,000 and all competitive tenders must be received by 1300 EDT/1700 GMT on April 8. Bidding is by single-price auction format and all bids must be expressed to three decimal places, Treasury said.
Noncompetitive bids will be accepted in full up to $5 million at the highest accepted yield.
